papers.title_zh: 贸易模型、贸易弹性与贸易收益

papers.title_en: The price of delay: Supply chain disruptions and pricing dynamics
papers.title_zh: 延迟的代价：供应链中断与定价动态

papers.title_en: Tariffs and goods-market search frictions
papers.title_zh: 关税与商品市场搜索摩擦
papers.abstract_en: We study tariffs in a general equilibrium dynamic model with search frictions between heterogeneous exporting producers and importing retailers. We show the model has a unique equilibrium and analytically characterize home unilateral import tariffs that maximize welfare given a passive foreign country. Search frictions add two terms to the standard optimal tariff expression: One lowers tariffs when contact rates are low; another when private export costs exceed social opportunity costs. Search frictions also introduce new incentives to subsidize imports due to market thickness effects. We calibrate our baseline to U.S. and Chinese 2016 data. We compare this baseline to a counterfactual with international search costs reduced to domestic levels but with all other parameters fixed. We find that higher baseline search costs reduce optimal U.S. unilateral and Nash tariffs and attenuate welfare responses to tariff changes. • General equilibrium trade model with search frictions has unique equilibrium. • Optimal tariff formula includes import markdowns and search externalities. • Search frictions incentivize import subsidies via market thickness effects. • Search frictions attenuate tariffs’ effects on welfare. • Calibrated optimal tariff is lower with higher search costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个具有异质性出口生产商和进口零售商之间搜索摩擦的一般均衡动态模型中的关税问题。我们展示了该模型具有唯一的均衡，并分析了在外国被动的情况下，最大化福利的国内单边进口关税。搜索摩擦在标准最优关税表达式中增加了两个项：一个在联系率低时降低关税；另一个在私人出口成本超过社会机会成本时。搜索摩擦还引入了通过市场厚度效应补贴进口的新激励。我们将基线校准为2016年美国和中国的数据。我们将这个基线与一个国际搜索成本降低到国内水平的反事实进行比较，但所有其他参数保持不变。我们发现，更高的基线搜索成本降低了最优的美国单边和纳什关税，并减弱了关税变化对福利的响应。•具有搜索摩擦的一般均衡贸易模型具有唯一的均衡。•最优关税公式包括进口降价和搜索外部性。•搜索摩擦通过市场厚度效应激励进口补贴。•搜索摩擦减弱了关税对福利的影响。•校准的最优关税在搜索成本更高时更低。

papers.title_en: The art of not being chocked: Environmental awareness, residents' responses and land transactions in China
papers.title_zh: 不被“窒息”的艺术：环境意识、居民响应与中国土地交易

papers.title_en: C'est la vie!: Mixed impacts of an edutainment television series in West Africa
papers.title_zh: 这就是生活！：西非一个教育娱乐电视系列的混合影响
papers.abstract_en: Edutainment is a promising tool for changing behavior at scale, yet little is known about how to maximize impacts. We undertake an experimental evaluation of a popular West African television series, C’est la vie!, delivered through film clubs targeted at adolescent girls and young women in rural Senegal. We examine impacts on violence against women and girls and sexual and reproductive health. Results show C’est la vie! improved knowledge on both domains three months after film clubs ended, as well as violence-related attitudes nine months later, however, had no impact on behaviors. We investigate design components intended to strengthen impacts, generally finding no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts. Our findings suggest that edutainment is an engaging way to reach viewers on sensitive themes, however more evidence is needed on how to effectively deliver edutainment content for sustained behavior change at scale. • Using a cluster randomized control trial, we evaluate a popular West African TV series. • We examine impacts on violence against women and girls (VAWG) and sexual and reproductive health (SRH). • We find short term knowledge gains in both domains and improved medium term VAWG attitudes. • We find no impact on behaviors. • We find no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts.
papers.abstract_zh: 教育娱乐是改变大规模行为的有前途的工具，但如何最大化影响却鲜为人知。我们对西非流行的电视剧《这就是生活！》进行了实验性评估，该剧通过针对塞内加尔农村少女和年轻女性的电影节俱乐部进行传播。我们检验了对针对妇女和女童的暴力行为以及性和生殖健康的影响。结果显示，《这就是生活！》在电影节结束后三个月提高了两个领域的知识，九个月后改善了与暴力相关的态度，但对行为没有影响。我们调查了旨在加强影响的设计要素，通常发现放映后讨论、吸引男性和播客没有额外影响。我们的发现表明，教育娱乐是吸引观众关注敏感主题的有趣方式，但需要更多证据来了解如何有效地传播教育娱乐内容，以实现大规模的持续行为改变。• 我们使用集群随机对照试验评估了一部流行的西非电视剧。• 我们检验了对针对妇女和女童的暴力行为（VAWG）和性和生殖健康（SRH）的影响。• 我们发现在两个领域都有短期知识收益和中期VAWG态度的改善。• 我们发现对行为没有影响。• 我们发现放映后讨论、吸引男性和播客没有额外影响。

papers.title_en: It will rain: The effect of information on flood preparedness in urban Mozambique
papers.title_zh: 洪水将至：信息对城市莫桑比克洪水准备的影响
papers.abstract_en: Floods are among the costliest and most recurring natural hazards. Many governments provide disaster preparedness information, but there is limited evidence of its effectiveness. Using a randomized experiment across 300 urban communities in Mozambique, I show that providing information on flood risk increased the implementation of suggested mitigation strategies, measured objectively (using a machine learning-based algorithm to detect solid waste, a major flood hazard, in over 25,000 photos) and through self-reported behaviors. Sending flood preparedness text messages proved to be at least as effective as more resource-intensive interventions that involved household visits and video screenings. Risk perception increased, particularly in lower-risk areas, suggesting that information and past experiences contribute to community preparedness by shaping perceived flood risk. These findings highlight the importance of communication in mobilizing communities for disaster risk management, even in contexts where flood risks are presumably already well-known, and underscore the potential of low-cost, scalable communication tools. • Flood preparedness information raised mitigation behavior in urban Mozambique. • Text messages were as effective as costlier video interventions. • Solid waste near drainage canals fell by 6–13 percentage points. • Machine learning from 25k photos provided objective behavior measures. • Low-cost communication tools can enhance urban climate resilience.
papers.abstract_zh: 洪水是最昂贵且最频繁发生的自然灾害之一。许多政府提供灾害准备信息，但关于其有效性的证据有限。通过在莫桑比克300个城市社区进行的随机实验，我展示了提供洪水风险信息增加了实施建议的减灾策略，这些策略通过客观测量（使用基于机器学习的算法在超过25,000张照片中检测固体废物，这是主要的洪水危害）和自我报告的行为来衡量。发送洪水准备短信被证明至少与涉及家庭访问和视频放映的更资源密集的干预措施一样有效。风险感知增加，特别是在低风险地区，这表明信息和过去的经历通过塑造感知的洪水风险，有助于社区准备。这些发现强调了沟通在动员社区进行灾害风险管理中的重要性，即使在洪水风险被认为已经众所周知的背景下，也强调了低成本、可扩展的沟通工具的潜力。• 洪水准备信息提高了莫桑比克城市地区的减灾行为。• 短信与成本更高的视频干预一样有效。• 排水渠附近的固体废物减少了6-13个百分点。• 从25k张照片中进行的机器学习提供了客观的行为测量。• 低成本的沟通工具可以增强城市气候韧性。

papers.title_en: Foreign interventions and community cohesion in times of conflict
papers.title_zh: 外干预与冲突时期的社区凝聚力
papers.abstract_en: The success of foreign interventions critically depends on cohesion within local communities, which serve as relevant partners in counterinsurgency and reconstruction efforts. Using unique data on military base locations and counterinsurgency aid in Afghanistan, I show that the presence of the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) negatively affects social cohesion, measured by support within communities, engagement with community institutions, and trust. I leverage a geographic regression discontinuity design to estimate effects of ISAF’s geographic mandate enlargement, complemented by a panel analysis that covers its operational intensification. These findings do not appear to reflect crowding-out of informal institutions by formal provision; rather, they coincide with higher insecurity and reduced confidence in local institutions, offering a plausible explanation for the observed erosion of community cohesion. These findings carry important implications for foreign policy, particularly in settings where communities compensate for gaps in formal institutional provision. • The study uses geocoded data on foreign military bases and counterinsurgency aid. • Geographic RD and panel evidence identify effects of expansion and intensity. • Foreign military presence weakened social cohesion in Afghanistan (2005–2010). • No evidence of crowding out; results linked to higher insecurity and lower confidence. • Results align with qualitative evidence from post-intervention “lessons learned”
papers.abstract_zh: 外国干预的成功在很大程度上取决于当地社区的凝聚力，这些社区在反叛乱和重建努力中扮演着相关伙伴的角色。利用阿富汗军事基地位置和反叛乱援助的独特数据，我展示了国际安全援助部队（ISAF）的存在对社会凝聚力产生了负面影响，这种凝聚力通过社区内的支持、与社区机构的参与以及信任来衡量。我利用地理回归不连续设计来估计ISAF地理任务扩大的效果，并辅以涵盖其行动强度化的面板分析。这些发现似乎并不反映非正式机构被正式提供挤出；相反，它们与更高的不安全感和对当地机构信心的降低相吻合，为观察到的社区凝聚力的侵蚀提供了一个合理的解释。这些发现对外交政策具有重要意义，特别是在社区补偿正式制度提供缺口的背景下。• 研究使用了外国军事基地和反叛乱援助的地理编码数据。• 地理RD和面板证据识别了扩张和强度的效果。• 外国军事存在削弱了阿富汗的社会凝聚力（2005-2010年）。• 没有挤出的证据；结果与更高的不安全感和更低的信心相关。• 结果与干预后“经验教训”的定性证据一致。

papers.title_en: Chat over coffee? Diffusion of agronomic practices and market spillovers in Rwanda
papers.title_zh: 咖啡聊天？卢旺达农艺实践的传播与市场溢出效应

papers.title_en: Parental mental health and the economic preferences of the next generation
papers.title_zh: 父母心理健康与下一代的经济偏好
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence that children's economic preferences vary systematically with parental mental health. Using experimentally elicited measures of economic preferences from more than 4,500 children in Bangladesh, we document that children of parents with indications of mental illness are less prosocial but more patient than their peers with mentally healthy parents. Attitudes toward risk remain unchanged. We discuss potential pathways through which parental mental health may influence the formation of children's preferences, documenting that children of parents with indication of mental illness assume greater responsibilities within the family, experience less parental involvement, and are exposed to a more adverse home environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了儿童经济偏好与父母心理健康系统性变化的证据。利用来自孟加拉国4500多名儿童的经济偏好实验性测量数据，我们记录了有精神健康问题迹象的父母的孩子比心理健康的父母的孩子更不亲社会但更有耐心。对风险的态度保持不变。我们讨论了父母心理健康可能影响儿童偏好形成的潜在途径，记录了有精神健康问题迹象的父母的孩子在家庭中承担更多责任，经历较少的父母参与，并暴露于更不利的家庭环境。

papers.title_en: The limits of local laws in global supply chains: Cutting ties or “edutrading” procurement partners?
papers.title_zh: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育交易”采购伙伴？
papers.abstract_en: We study the procurement patterns of non-listed firms and examine how these often-overlooked, yet pivotal players in global supply chains adjust their sourcing when they anticipate accountability for externalities beyond their organizational boundaries. Using granular customs data and a surprise information release about the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act, product-level regressions reveal that importing firms are 3.5 percentage points less likely to source a product from countries where the relevant production sector exhibits elevated ESG-related risks, suggesting that firms tend to cut ties with higher-risk suppliers. The effects are concentrated among firms with well-diversified supplier networks for a product and higher profitability, suggesting they have the necessary flexibility to respond quickly to anticipated regulatory pressure. Our findings suggest that mandates requiring firms to incorporate broad sustainability considerations into their operational decisions may have limits, particularly for non-listed firms. • Can regulation mandating firms to “edutrade” suppliers be effective? • Accountability for supply chain ESG risks linked to dropping risky suppliers. • Diversified supplier network and high profits allow firms to adjust sourcing. • Big Four-audited firms show stronger procurement adjustments. • Potential limits of supply chain due diligence mandates for non-listed firms.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非上市公司的采购模式，并检验了这些常被忽视但在全球供应链中扮演关键角色的参与者在预期对组织边界之外的外部性负责时，如何调整其采购来源。利用详细的海关数据和关于德国供应链尽职调查法的意外信息发布，产品级别的回归分析显示，进口公司从相关生产部门表现出较高ESG相关风险的国家采购产品的可能性低3.5个百分点，这表明公司倾向于切断与高风险供应商的联系。这些效应集中在拥有产品多样化供应商网络和较高盈利能力的公司中，表明它们有必要的灵活性，能够迅速响应预期的监管压力。我们的发现表明，要求公司将广泛的可持续性考虑纳入其运营决策的法规可能存在局限性，特别是对于非上市公司。• 规定公司“教育贸易”供应商的法规能否有效？• 对供应链ESG风险的问责与放弃风险供应商相关。• 多样化的供应商网络和高利润使公司能够调整采购。• 四大审计公司显示出更强的采购调整。• 非上市公司供应链尽职调查法规的潜在局限性。

papers.title_en: Landmine clearance and economic development: Evidence from multispectral satellite imagery, nighttime lights, and conflict events in Afghanistan
papers.title_zh: 扫雷与经济发展：来自阿富汗多光谱卫星图像、夜间灯光和冲突事件的证据
papers.abstract_en: The widespread prevalence of unexploded landmines in many countries leads to thousands of deaths and injuries annually. In addition, landmines may block transport corridors–restricting the flow of goods and people–and prevent the productive use of contaminated land. We study the clearance of more than 15,000 hazardous areas in Afghanistan over the past several decades, obtaining precise geographic boundaries for these areas. We use multispectral Landsat-series imagery to develop measures of land use and crop productivity, allowing us to detect effects even in rural areas, where impacts have been more difficult to observe in prior papers relying on nighttime lights as proxies of economic activity. We conduct event study estimations of the impacts of clearance, leveraging the staggered roll-out of this clearance while avoiding forbidden comparisons. The clearance of hazardous areas leads to changes in land use and agricultural productivity, as well as broader increases in economic activity reflected in nighttime lights. We also find reductions in conflict risks due to the clearance of hazardous areas. Landmine action efforts appear to have substantial economic effects even in areas with ongoing conflict risks. • Widespread prevalence of unexploded landmines in many countries leads to thousands of deaths and injuries annually, blocks transport corridors, and prevents productive use of contaminated land. • Study the clearance of more than 15,000 hazardous areas in Afghanistan over the past several decades, leveraging staggered roll-out to conduct event study designs. • Use multispectral Landsat-series imagery to develop measures of land use and crop productivity, detecting effects even in rural areas, where impacts previously more difficult to observe. • Clearance of hazardous areas leads to economic improvements in urban areas with better market access, as well as land use changes and crop productivity improvements in rural areas. • Clearance also leads to reductions in nearby conflict risks, likely because clearance of agricultural land raises opportunity costs of engaging in conflict.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多国家广泛存在的未爆炸地雷每年导致数千人死亡和受伤。此外，地雷可能阻塞交通走廊，限制货物和人员的流动，并阻止受污染土地的生产性使用。我们研究了过去几十年在阿富汗清除超过15,000个危险区域的情况，获得了这些区域的精确地理界限。我们使用多光谱Landsat系列影像来开发土地使用和作物生产力的衡量标准，使我们能够检测到即使在农村地区的影响，这些影响在以前依赖夜间灯光作为经济活动代理的论文中更难以观察到。我们利用清除工作的错开推出进行事件研究估计，避免进行禁忌比较。清除危险区域导致土地使用和农业生产力的变化，以及夜间灯光反映的经济活动的更广泛增加。我们还发现，由于清除危险区域，冲突风险有所降低。即使在存在持续冲突风险的地区，地雷行动工作似乎也具有重大的经济影响。• 许多国家广泛存在的未爆炸地雷每年导致数千人死亡和受伤，阻塞交通走廊，并阻止受污染土地的生产性使用。• 研究过去几十年在阿富汗清除超过15,000个危险区域的情况，利用错开推出进行事件研究设计。• 使用多光谱Landsat系列影像来开发土地使用和作物生产力的衡量标准，即使在农村地区也能检测到影响，这些影响以前更难以观察到。• 清除危险区域导致城市地区经济状况改善，市场准入更好，以及农村地区土地使用变化和作物生产力提高。• 清除还导致附近冲突风险的降低，很可能是因为清除农业土地提高了参与冲突的机会成本。

papers.title_en: Women political leaders as agents of environmental change
papers.title_zh: 女性政治领袖作为环境变革的推动者
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores how female political leaders impact environmental outcomes and climate change policy actions using data from mixed-gender mayoral races in Brazil. We rely on a Regression Discontinuity design that compares municipalities where women narrowly won the election with those where men narrowly won. This strategy allows us to identify the causal effect of a woman winning the mayoral election. We find that, compared to male mayors, female mayors significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions and deforestation in the municipalities with Amazon biome. Specifically, when a woman wins the election, annual greenhouse gas emissions decrease by 1,510 thousand tons of CO2e per municipality in the Amazon. This effect alone represents 23% of the average annual emissions of all municipalities within the Amazon biome and 6.4% of Brazil's nationwide average. This reduction is driven by a reduction in emissions intensity (CO2e/GDP) in the Land Use sector, without changes in municipal economic activity. Part of the reduction in emissions in the Land Use sector is attributable to a decline in deforestation. Specifically, female-led municipalities in the Amazon experience a reduction in deforestation, with a 3 percentage-point decrease in the loss of forest formations relative to the baseline forest cover. This represents a 32% reduction compared to deforestation levels in the comparison municipalities. We examine potential mechanisms that could explain the positive environmental impact of narrowly electing a female mayor over a male counterpart and find that in Amazon municipalities, female elected mayors allocate more space to the environment in their government proposals and are more likely to invest in environmental initiatives. Differences in the enforcement of environmental regulations and the level of education of elected female and male mayors do not explain the results.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西混合性别市长竞选的数据，探讨女性政治领导人如何影响环境结果和气候变化政策行动。我们依赖于一种回归不连续设计，比较女性以微弱优势赢得选举的市镇与男性以微弱优势赢得选举的市镇。这种策略使我们能够识别女性赢得市长选举的因果效应。我们发现，与男性市长相比，女性市长显著减少了拥有亚马逊生物群系的市镇的温室气体排放和森林砍伐。具体来说，当女性赢得选举时，亚马逊地区的市镇每年温室气体排放量减少了1510万吨CO2e。这一效应单独就占到了亚马逊生物群系内所有市镇平均年排放量的23%，以及巴西全国平均水平的6.4%。这种减少是由土地利用部门排放强度（CO2e/GDP）的减少驱动的，而市镇经济活动没有变化。土地利用部门排放减少的部分原因是森林砍伐的减少。具体来说，由女性领导的亚马逊市镇经历了森林砍伐的减少，与基线森林覆盖相比，森林形态的损失减少了3个百分点。与对照市镇的森林砍伐水平相比，这代表了32%的减少。我们检验了可能解释以微弱优势选举女性市长而非男性对手对环境产生积极影响的潜在机制，并发现在亚马逊市镇，当选的女性市长在政府提案中为环境分配了更多的空间，并且更有可能投资于环境倡议。当选的女性和男性市长在执行环境法规和教育水平上的差异并不能解释这些结果。

papers.title_en: Ancestral irrigation and collective climate action
papers.title_zh: 祖传灌溉与集体气候行动
papers.abstract_en: This study examines the long-term legacy of ancestral irrigation for contemporary climate change policies. Using geographic suitability for irrigated agriculture as a plausibly exogenous source of variation in historical irrigation adoption, we find that societies whose ancestors jointly practiced irrigated agriculture during the pre-industrial era tend to adopt less effective climate change policies today. Additional evidence suggests that pro-climate political responses to the growing salience of climate action, driven by exposure to severe natural disasters, are significantly weaker in societies historically dependent on irrigated agriculture. We propose and document empirically that ancestral irrigation, marked by intensive neighborhood-based cooperation and interdependence, contributed to the early formation of tight kinship networks. These networks likely constrained impersonal cooperation across kin boundaries, weakening collective pro-climate action. • This study examines a potential historical origin of variation in cooperative norms relevant for climate change mitigation. • Societies whose ancestors jointly practiced irrigated agriculture during the pre-industrial era tend to adopt less effective climate change policies today. • Pro-climate political responses to the growing salience of climate action are significantly weaker in societies historically dependent on irrigated agriculture. • Ancestral irrigation, marked by intensive neighborhood-based cooperation and interdependence, contributed to the early formation of tight kinship networks. • Ancestral kinship tightness likely constrained impersonal cooperation across kin boundaries, weakening collective pro-climate action.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了祖先灌溉对当代气候变化政策的长期影响。利用地理适宜性作为灌溉农业的外生变量来源，我们发现那些在前工业时代祖先共同实践灌溉农业的社会，今天往往采取效果较差的气候变化政策。额外证据表明，受严重自然灾害影响，历史上依赖灌溉农业的社会在应对气候行动日益显著的政治响应中，对气候的积极政治反应明显较弱。我们提出并实证记录，祖先灌溉，以基于社区的密集合作和相互依存为标志，促成了早期紧密血缘网络的形成。这些网络可能限制了跨血缘界限的非个人合作，削弱了集体支持气候行动。• 本研究考察了与气候变化缓解相关的合作规范变化的潜在历史起源。• 那些在前工业时代祖先共同实践灌溉农业的社会，今天往往采取效果较差的气候变化政策。• 历史上依赖灌溉农业的社会，在应对气候行动日益显著的政治响应中，对气候的积极政治反应明显较弱。• 祖先灌溉，以基于社区的密集合作和相互依存为标志，促成了早期紧密血缘网络的形成。• 祖先血缘紧密性可能限制了跨血缘界限的非个人合作，削弱了集体支持气候行动。

papers.title_en: Revisiting the Leontief Paradox From a Value‐Added Trade Perspective
papers.title_zh: 从增加值贸易视角重新审视列昂惕夫悖论
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study revisits a well‐known thesis in international trade theory—the Leontief paradox—from a value‐added trade perspective within a global industrial linkage framework. Using the Heckscher–Ohlin model as a foundation, this paper employs world input–output tables and socioeconomic accounts compiled by the European Union to calculate the value added embodied in bilateral trade for specific economies. The analysis computes the capital‐to‐labor ratios of all traded goods for these economies from 2000 to 2014, aiming to identify the potential existence of the Leontief paradox. Our findings reveal that the Leontief paradox appears in many instances in the United States, especially within the services sector. However, when the value‐added trade concept is applied, the paradox is observed only in a few bilateral cases in the services sector. By contrast, the Leontief paradox is almost nonexistent in India, as a developing country with an abundant labor endowment, whether from a conventional trade perspective or a value‐added trade one is used.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究从全球产业联系框架中的价值增加贸易视角重新审视国际贸易理论中一个著名的论题——列昂惕夫悖论。本文以赫克歇尔-俄林模型为基础，利用欧盟编制的世界投入产出表和社会经济账户，计算特定经济体双边贸易中所包含的价值增加。分析计算了2000年至2014年这些经济体所有贸易商品的资本-劳动比率，旨在识别列昂惕夫悖论的潜在存在。我们的发现揭示了列昂惕夫悖论在美国许多情况下都会出现，特别是在服务业领域。然而，当应用价值增加贸易概念时，悖论仅在服务业的少数双边案例中被观察到。相比之下，作为一个拥有丰富劳动力禀赋的发展中国家，印度几乎不存在列昂惕夫悖论，无论是从传统贸易视角还是价值增加贸易视角来看。

papers.title_en: The Impact of Foreign Direct Investment on Firms' Cash Holdings: Evidence From China
papers.title_zh: 外商直接投资对企业现金持有的影响：来自中国的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This paper investigates how foreign direct investment (FDI) affects firms' cash holdings in manufacturing sectors by taking the plausibly exogenous shock of FDI liberalization in 2002 as an instrumental variable. Using data from the Chinese annual survey of industrial firms from 1998 to 2007, it is found that a 1% increase in industry‐level FDI decreases firms' cash holdings by 7.10% on average. Two explanations of the effect of FDI, that is, investment squeezing and financial constraint alleviation, are explored. Both mechanisms lead to a decrease in firms' cash holdings. In contrast to the effect of horizontal FDI, vertical FDI sourced from upstream industries exerts a positive effect on firms' cash holdings. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses suggest that the reduction in cash holdings caused by FDI inflows mainly affects smaller firms, privately owned firms, and firms belonging to competitive industries.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文利用2002年外商直接投资（FDI）自由化的外生冲击作为工具变量，研究了FDI如何影响制造业企业现金持有量。利用1998至2007年中国工业企业年度调查数据，发现行业层面FDI每增加1%，企业现金持有量平均减少7.10%。文章探讨了FDI效应的两种解释，即投资挤出效应和金融约束缓解效应，两种机制均导致企业现金持有量减少。与水平FDI不同，来自上游产业的垂直FDI对企业现金持有量产生正面影响。此外，异质性分析表明，FDI流入引起的现金持有量减少主要影响小型企业、私营企业和竞争性行业的企业。

papers.title_en: Labor‐Eliminating Technological Progress and Foreign Direct Investment
papers.title_zh: 劳动替代型技术进步与外商直接投资
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Capital‐scarce emerging economies/developing countries often depend heavily on the inflow of foreign direct investment (FDI) to sustain economic growth. However, if a developing economy experiences labor‐eliminating technological change through the adoption of automating technologies in manufacturing, an inflow of capital may replace labor in manufacturing. This, in turn, may compel policymakers to advocate for a foreign investment tax to restrict the inflow of capital. Contrary to this view, we show that in such an environment, wages will rise, and any policy that restricts the inflow of foreign capital does not benefit workers.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：资本稀缺的新兴经济体/发展中国家往往严重依赖外国直接投资（FDI）流入以维持经济增长。然而，如果一个发展中经济体通过在制造业采用自动化技术经历劳动替代型技术变革，资本流入可能会取代制造业中的劳动力。这反过来可能会迫使政策制定者主张征收外国投资税以限制资本流入。与此观点相反，我们表明，在这种环境下，工资将会上升，任何限制外国资本流入的政策都不会使工人受益。

papers.title_en: Conflict and Knowledge Flows: Evidence From the 9/11 Attacks
papers.title_zh: 冲突与知识流动：9/11袭击的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We assess how geopolitical conflict affects cross‐border knowledge flows by exploring an unexpected event: the 9/11 attacks. Exploiting cross‐country patent citation, collaboration data from the PATSTAT (1990–2015), patent transaction and grant outcome data from Bureau van Dijk's Orbis (Q1 2001–Q4 2003), we show that the trust ‐erosion shock between ethnic groups significantly reduced knowledge flows between NATO and Muslim‐majority countries, with sharper declines in high‐ trust sectors and patents involving Muslim inventors. Our analysis reveals that trust erosion, rather than conventional economic channels like trade, FDI, or migration serves as the primary mechanism, evidenced by asymmetric knowledge flow patterns, and mitigated effects for Muslim‐majority countries with stronger pre‐existing NATO ties. Our results highlight the enduring impact of geopolitical conflict on knowledge flows, underscoring trust as a critical yet vulnerable component for global knowledge exchange.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过研究一个意外事件：9/11恐怖袭击，来评估地缘政治冲突如何影响跨境知识流动。利用PATSTAT（1990-2015年）的跨国专利引用和合作数据，以及Bureau van Dijk的Orbis（2001年第一季度至2003年第四季度）的专利交易和授权结果数据，我们发现民族群体间信任侵蚀的冲击显著减少了北约和穆斯林占多数国家之间的知识流动，特别是在高信任部门和涉及穆斯林发明人的专利中下降更为明显。我们的分析揭示，信任侵蚀，而非传统的经济渠道如贸易、外国直接投资或移民，是主要机制，这一点从不对称的知识流动模式和对与北约关系更紧密的穆斯林占多数国家影响较小中得到证明。我们的结果强调了地缘政治冲突对知识流动的持久影响，强调信任是全球知识交换中一个关键但脆弱的组成部分。

papers.title_en: Services Liberalization and Manufacturing Imports: Evidence From Chinese Firms
papers.title_zh: 服务自由化与制造业进口：来自中国企业的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study investigates how services liberalization influences firm import behavior, leveraging China's 2002 revision of the Catalogue for the Guidance of Foreign Investment Industries (CIFD) as a quasi‐natural experiment. Using Chinese firm‐level panel data, we demonstrate that services liberalization significantly increases imports by alleviating financing constraints, expanding production scale, and enhancing production efficiency. These effects are more pronounced among non‐state‐owned firms, upstream manufacturers, capital‐intensive industries, and exporters. Although services liberalization increases imports of intermediate and capital goods, it exerts no significant impact on consumer goods imports. Sectoral analysis reveals positive effects from liberalizing finance, distribution, and transportation. Furthermore, an analysis employing a region‐industry‐year perspective based on China's post‐WTO commitments under the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS) robustly corroborates these findings. Broader conceptual analysis shows that services liberalization also facilitates firms' entry into import markets, expands their imported product baskets, upgrades import quality, accelerates industry‐level import growth, and induces product switching. Finally, we establish that import growth spurred by liberalization enhances firm performance, highlighting its tangible economic benefits.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究利用中国2002年修订的《外商投资产业指导目录》（CIFD）作为准自然实验，探讨服务业自由化如何影响企业的进口行为。利用中国企业层面的面板数据，我们证明服务业自由化通过缓解融资约束、扩大生产规模和提高生产效率显著增加了进口。这些效应在非国有企业、上游制造商、资本密集型行业和出口商中更为明显。尽管服务业自由化增加了中间品和资本货物的进口，但对消费品进口没有显著影响。行业分析显示，金融、分销和运输的自由化产生了积极效应。此外，基于中国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）后在《服务贸易总协定》（GATS）下的承诺，采用地区-行业-年份视角的分析也有力地证实了这些发现。更广泛的概念分析表明，服务业自由化还促进了企业进入进口市场，扩大了它们的进口产品篮子，提高了进口质量，加速了行业层面的进口增长，并引发了产品转换。最后，我们确立了自由化刺激的进口增长提高了企业绩效，突出了其有形的经济利益。

papers.title_en: Nipping Alcohol or Sipping Coffee: Two Tales of Beverages and Their Industrial Growth in the National Cultural Setting
papers.title_zh: 饮酒还是品咖啡：两种饮品及其在国家文化背景下的产业增长故事
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT As global consumption patterns shift, coffee is rising as a productivity‐linked stimulant while alcohol is declining amid public health and cultural transformations. This study tests the hypothesis that coffee consumption substitutes for alcohol consumption and explores how national culture moderates this relationship. At the substitution effect level, we used the competing logic between two beverages. At the moderation level, we used cultural values as contingencies. Using a robust cross‐national dataset of alcohol consumption as the outcome and coffee consumption as the predictor in 112 countries, we used multilevel analysis for the four cultural dimensions: Power Distance, Individualism, Masculinity, and Uncertainty Avoidance. The findings show that the cultural moderators strongly change the relationship between coffee and alcohol consumption levels. The interaction coefficients are significant between models, nested levels, and after reverse causality inclusion. Although the coefficient size and direction of the coefficients vary, the moderation effect of culture remains robust. These results reveal that the global contraction of alcohol consumption is not simply a function of rising coffee demand in universal patterns but is filtered through culturally embedded norms. The findings position national culture as a key institutional layer in shaping industry trajectories and consumer substitution effects, offering novel implications for international economics, public health policy, and cross‐cultural market strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：随着全球消费模式的转变，咖啡作为与生产力相关的刺激剂而崛起，而酒精消费则在公共卫生和文化转型中下降。本研究测试了咖啡消费替代酒精消费的假设，并探讨了国家文化如何调节这种关系。在替代效应层面，我们使用了两种饮料之间的竞争逻辑。在调节层面，我们使用文化价值观作为条件。利用112个国家的酒精消费作为结果和咖啡消费作为预测因子的稳健跨国数据集，我们对四个文化维度：权力距离、个人主义、男性气质和不确定性回避进行了多层次分析。研究结果表明，文化调节因素强烈改变了咖啡和酒精消费水平之间的关系。模型之间、嵌套层次之间以及反向因果关系纳入后的交互系数均显著。尽管系数的大小和方向不同，但文化的调节效应仍然稳健。这些结果揭示了全球酒精消费的收缩不仅仅是普遍模式下咖啡需求上升的函数，而是通过文化内嵌的规范过滤的。这些发现将国家文化定位为塑造行业轨迹和消费者替代效应的关键制度层面，为国际经济学、公共卫生政策和跨文化市场策略提供了新的含义。

papers.title_en: Fossil Fuels, Trade Liberalization, and the Environment: Evidence From China
papers.title_zh: 化石燃料、贸易自由化与环境：来自中国的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This paper examines the environmental impact of trade liberalization on firms through two types of import tariff reductions. We find that lowering import tariffs on intermediate goods reduces both sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) emissions and emission intensity among Chinese firms. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we incorporate firms' pollution behavior into a procurement model and describe how the reduction in input tariffs decreases pollution by encouraging firms to switch from coal to crude oil in their production processes. Based on our model, we conduct an empirical analysis using detailed micro‐level data on firm pollution in China from 1998 to 2005. We find that the reduction in input tariffs led more firms, especially those previously heavily reliant on coal, to switch to oil, resulting in a decrease in firm‐level pollution. Additionally, we explore and rule out other potential channels that could influence firms' pollution intensity, including the pollution haven effect, entry–exit effect, and abatement investment effect. Overall, the findings of this paper provide new evidence on the environmental impact of trade liberalization in developing countries while also elucidating the underlying mechanisms of the “technique effect.”
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文通过两种类型的进口关税降低，考察了贸易自由化对企业环境影响。我们发现，降低中间产品的进口关税既减少了中国企业的二氧化硫（SO2）排放，也降低了排放强度。为了探索背后的机制，我们将企业的污染行为纳入采购模型，并描述了输入关税的降低如何通过鼓励企业在生产过程中从煤炭转向原油来减少污染。基于我们的模型，我们使用1998年至2005年中国企业污染的详细微观层面数据进行了实证分析。我们发现，输入关税的降低导致更多企业，特别是那些以前严重依赖煤炭的企业转向石油，从而降低了企业层面的污染。此外，我们还探讨并排除了其他可能影响企业污染强度的潜在渠道，包括污染避难所效应、进入-退出效应和减排投资效应。总体而言，本文的发现为发展中国家贸易自由化的环境影响提供了新的证据，同时也阐明了“技术效应”背后的机制。

papers.title_en: Asymmetric Exchange Rate Pass‐Through
papers.title_zh: 非对称汇率传递效应
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This article investigates how asymmetric exchange rate pass‐through affects the welfare costs of domestic and foreign productivity shocks. This is achieved by modifying a standard two‐country dynamic general equilibrium model to include an exchange rate pass‐through parameter. This parameter is empirically estimated using the local projections method on a panel of 84 countries, showing that pass‐through is significantly higher during currency depreciations, in periods of higher inflation, and in countries with higher exchange rate volatility. The corresponding welfare simulations suggest that domestic productivity shocks are most costly in cases of currency depreciation, higher inflation, and higher exchange rate volatility, whereas foreign productivity shocks result in significantly greater welfare losses in cases of currency appreciation, lower inflation, and lower exchange rate volatility. These findings imply that to mitigate welfare losses, policymakers should account for asymmetric exchange rate pass‐through, considering both state‐dependent economic conditions and the origin of the shock.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了非对称汇率传递对国内外生产率冲击福利成本的影响。通过在标准两国动态一般均衡模型中引入汇率传递参数来实现这一点。该参数使用局部投影方法在84个国家的面板数据上进行实证估计，结果显示，在货币贬值期间、高通胀时期以及汇率波动较大的国家，传递率显著更高。相应的福利模拟表明，在货币贬值、高通胀和高汇率波动的情况下，国内生产率冲击的成本最高，而国外生产率冲击在货币升值、低通胀和低汇率波动的情况下导致显著更大的福利损失。这些发现意味着，为了减轻福利损失，政策制定者应考虑非对称汇率传递，同时考虑依赖于经济状况的状态和冲击的来源。

papers.title_en: Extreme Heat and the Domestic Value‐Added Ratio in Exports
papers.title_zh: 极热天气与出口中的国内增加值比率
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The impact of climate change on economic activities is an issue of widespread global concern. Using firm‐level data from China during 2000–2014, this paper examines how local extreme heat shocks affect firms' participation in global value chains, measured by the domestic value‐added ratio in exports (DVAR). Our results reveal that one additional day with a temperature exceeding 33°C in a given year leads to a decrease of 0.138% in the DVAR of Chinese firms. A back‐of‐the‐envelope calculation for the entire country suggests that each extra day of extremely high temperature was associated with an annual loss of USD 16.19 million in value‐added through export. The underlying mechanisms operate through two main channels: a direct productivity channel, in which extreme heat lowers labor productivity, and an indirect substitution channel, whereby firms increase their reliance on imported intermediate inputs from regions with lower climate risks. These mechanisms suggest that local heat shocks can propagate across supply chains, reshaping international production patterns. By emphasizing how climate risks transmit through production networks, this study provides new evidence that environmental shocks can become important determinants of comparative advantage in global trade.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 气候变化对经济活动的影响是一个全球普遍关注的问题。本文利用2000-2014年中国企业层面数据，检验了当地极端高温冲击如何影响企业参与全球价值链的程度，以出口中的国内增加值比率（DVAR）来衡量。研究结果表明，一年中每增加一天温度超过33°C，中国企业的DVAR就会下降0.138%。对整个国家进行粗略计算表明，每增加一天极端高温，通过出口的增加值年度损失为1619万美元。这些机制通过两个主要渠道发挥作用：一是直接生产率渠道，极端高温降低了劳动生产率；二是间接替代渠道，企业增加了对气候风险较低地区进口中间产品的依赖。这些机制表明，当地热冲击可以通过供应链传播，重塑国际生产模式。通过强调气候风险如何通过生产网络传播，本研究提供了新的证据，表明环境冲击可能成为全球贸易中比较优势的重要决定因素。

papers.title_en: Extreme Capital Flow Episodes in Emerging Markets: Incidence and Drivers
papers.title_zh: 新兴市场中的极端资本流动事件：发生频率与驱动因素
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We update the dataset on extreme capital flow episodes (surges, stops, flight, and retrenchment), originally constructed by Forbes and Warnock, for 29 emerging markets from 1985 to 2020. We also create new datasets on episodes based on the components of capital flows (portfolio, banking, and foreign direct investment [FDI] flows). Using the datasets, we examine how the incidence and drivers of episodes have changed since the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) and how they differ between the various components of capital flows. We find that although the frequency of episodes has, in general, increased since the GFC, they have become more evenly distributed across time. Since the GFC, episodes have become less sensitive to changes in global risk and global growth and more sensitive to changes in oil prices. Finally, episodes based on portfolio and banking flows are correlated with global and domestic factors, while episodes based on FDI flows are more idiosyncratic.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们更新了Forbes和Warnock最初构建的1985至2020年间29个新兴市场极端资本流动事件（激增、停止、外逃和缩减）的数据集。我们还创建了基于资本流动组成部分（投资组合、银行和外国直接投资[FDI]流动）的新数据集。利用这些数据集，我们检验了自全球金融危机（GFC）以来事件的发生率和驱动因素如何变化，以及它们在不同资本流动组成部分之间有何不同。我们发现，尽管自GFC以来事件的频率总体上有所增加，但它们在时间上的分布变得更加均匀。自GFC以来，事件对全球风险和全球增长变化的敏感性降低，而对油价变化的敏感性增加。最后，基于投资组合和银行流动的事件与全球和国内因素相关，而基于FDI流动的事件更具特异性。

papers.title_en: Unobserved Wholesale Contracts
papers.title_zh: 未观察到的批发合同
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A manufacturer with private information about product quality sells through a retailer to end consumers. By hiding wholesale pricing contracts from end consumers, the manufacturer can hide his private information, eliminate signaling distortions and earn higher (expected) profit compared to observable wholesale pricing as well as direct selling; consumers may also earn higher surplus under such contracts even though they do not learn true product quality. Policies that mandate disclosure of quality or of upstream contracts can reduce welfare relative to the equilibrium with hidden contracts. We formalize this interaction as a class of intermediated signaling games—distinct from standard signaling models because of the hidden interaction with the intermediary—and introduce a new belief refinement, IC‐I, tailored to such games and analogous to the Intuitive Criterion.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：一个对产品质量有私有信息的制造商通过零售商向最终消费者销售产品。通过向最终消费者隐藏批发定价合同，制造商可以隐藏其私有信息，消除信号扭曲，并与可观察的批发定价以及直接销售相比获得更高的（预期）利润；即使消费者无法了解真实的产品质量，他们也可能在此类合同下获得更高的消费者剩余。强制披露质量或上游合同的政策可能会降低相对于隐藏合同均衡的福利。我们将这种互动形式化为一类中介信号博弈——由于与中介的隐藏互动而与标准信号模型不同——并引入一种新的信仰细化，IC-I，专为这类博弈量身定制，类似于直观标准。

papers.title_en: The Productivity Effect of Public–Private Partnership
papers.title_zh: 公私合作伙伴关系的生产率效应
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Public–Private partnerships (PPPs) are often employed by public authorities to deliver infrastructure and public services through contracts bundling construction, operation, and maintenance over extended periods. Using a novel dataset covering the universe of Italian district heating plants (DHs) from 2007 to 2014, I show that PPP improves firm‐level productivity by incentivizing investments in higher capital quality. Capital quality—proxied by a thermal density index derived from the characteristics of the DH pipeline network—significantly improves productivity only when combined with PPP procurement. A structural production function approach reveals that a one‐unit increase in capital quality raises output by 19% in PPP firms, with negligible effects in non‐PPP firms. Counterfactual calculations suggest that enforcing PPP‐like quality standards across all plants would increase average output by 3266 MWh and reduce CO 2 emissions by 1568 tons per plant per year. The results are robust to selection bias, measurement error, and functional form misspecification. While this paper provides the first evidence that PPPs enhance productivity in network utilities by internalizing technological externalities between construction and operation, whether these gains fully translate into welfare improvements through pricing and Value for Money remains an open question for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）常被公共当局用来通过合同捆绑建设、运营和维护，长期提供基础设施和公共服务。利用覆盖2007至2014年意大利区域供热厂（DH）全样本的新数据集，我展示了PPP通过激励对更高资本质量的投资，提高了企业层面的生产率。资本质量——由DH管网特性衍生的热密度指数代理——只有在与PPP采购结合时才显著提高生产率。结构生产函数方法揭示，在PPP企业中，资本质量每增加一个单位，产出增加19%，而非PPP企业的影响微不足道。反事实计算表明，强制所有工厂执行类似PPP的质量标准，将使平均产出增加3266兆瓦时，每厂每年减少1568吨二氧化碳排放。结果对选择偏差、测量误差和函数形式误设具有鲁棒性。虽然本文首次提供了PPP通过内部化建设与运营之间的技术外部性来提高网络公用事业生产率的证据，但这些收益是否完全转化为通过定价和物有所值带来的福利改善，仍是未来研究的开放问题。

papers.title_en: Financial Incentives for the Development of Blockchain‐Based Platforms
papers.title_zh: 基于区块链平台发展的财政激励措施
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT I develop a theoretical model showing that an entrepreneur prefers to create a decentralized digital platform with a crypto‐token as its internal currency (rather than a traditional platform) when the total surplus from trade is low relative to the dollar value of transactions. I then study inefficiencies in the development of such platforms. When external funding is not required, effort may be above or below its efficient level. When external funding is required, multiple Pareto‐ranked equilibria arise: in each, with strictly positive probability, the entrepreneur liquidates his tokens and halts development.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：我构建了一个理论模型，表明当贸易产生的总剩余相对于交易的美元价值较低时，企业家更倾向于创建一个以加密代币为内部货币的去中心化数字平台（而不是传统平台）。然后，我研究了这类平台开发中的效率问题。当不需要外部融资时，努力水平可能高于或低于其有效水平。当需要外部融资时，会出现多个帕累托排序的均衡：在每个均衡中，以严格正的概率，企业家清算其代币并停止开发。

papers.title_en: Transparency and Innovation in Organizations
papers.title_zh: 组织透明度与创新
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study how transparency—the observability of interim performance measures—affects innovation incentives. In each of two periods, an agent selects either a new or well‐established idea and exerts effort to implement that idea into products or services. Transparency promotes idea exploration by allowing idea switching in response to negative signals. However, this can become counterproductive by wasting the knowledge acquired through implementation effort and reducing effort incentives if the output relies heavily on implementation effort rather than idea quality. Paradoxically, transparency can be further counterproductive if (1) the acquired knowledge becomes less idea‐specific, (2) the variance in idea quality increases, or (3) the interim performance measure becomes more precise.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究透明度——中间绩效指标的可观察性——如何影响创新激励。在两个时期中，代理人选择一个新想法或一个成熟的想法，并努力将该想法实施到产品或服务中。透明度通过允许在收到负面信号时切换想法来促进想法探索。然而，如果产出严重依赖于实施努力而不是想法质量，这可能会适得其反，浪费通过实施努力获得的知识，并减少努力激励。矛盾的是，如果（1）获得的知识变得不那么特定于想法，（2）想法质量的方差增加，或（3）中间绩效指标变得更加精确，透明度可能会进一步适得其反。

papers.title_en: Physicians as Persuaders: Evidence from Hospitals in China
papers.title_zh: 医生作为说服者：来自中国的医院证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT I estimate a Bayesian persuasion model to examine how financial incentives and asymmetric information shape physician–patient interactions. This approach offers new insights into the role of insurance. First, the model predicts that patients' coinsurance moderates physicians' responsiveness to increases in service fees. This prediction is supported by a difference‐in‐differences analysis using Chinese health insurance claims data with random variation in physicians' reimbursement and patients' coinsurance rates. Second, the model implies that lower coinsurance rates reduce both patient price elasticity and skepticism, increasing the likelihood of physicians misdirecting patients toward unnecessary treatments. Using structural model estimates, I show that for a diagnosis where surgical treatment is discretionary, nearly half of the patients who received surgery would not have done so were they fully informed. Such misdirection from physicians is greater when coinsurance rates decrease, highlighting a new inefficiency channel beyond moral hazard. I decompose the effect of lowering coinsurance into moral hazard and the novel greater misdirection effect. Counterfactual analysis shows that, while patients benefit from lower out‐of‐pocket costs, greater misdirection nearly offsets these welfare gains.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：我估计了一个贝叶斯说服模型，以检验金融激励和信息不对称如何塑造医生与患者之间的互动。这种方法为保险的作用提供了新的见解。首先，模型预测患者的共同保险会调节医生对服务费增加的反应。这一预测得到了使用中国健康保险索赔数据的差异-差异分析的支持，这些数据中医生的报销和患者的共同保险率存在随机变化。其次，模型意味着较低的共同保险率降低了患者的价格弹性和怀疑，增加了医生误导患者接受不必要治疗的可能性。利用结构模型估计，我展示了在诊断中手术治疗是自由裁量的情况下，几乎一半接受手术的患者如果完全知情就不会这样做。当共同保险率降低时，医生的这种误导更大，突出了一个超越道德风险的新效率损失渠道。我将降低共同保险的影响分解为道德风险和新的更大误导效应。反事实分析表明，尽管患者从较低的自付成本中受益，但更大的误导几乎抵消了这些福利收益。

papers.title_en: Strategic Trading and Blockholder Dynamics
papers.title_zh: 战略交易与大股东动态
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study strategic trading by a privately informed blockholder who monitors a company and trades its shares. Private information results in larger block sizes in good states, but by increasing the speed of the blockholder's selling, it can result in lower block sizes in bad states. Despite the heterogeneous impact on expected block size, we show that asymmetric information leads to Pareto improvements: it raises stock prices, benefits small uninformed shareholders, and benefits the block owner, despite the negative impact on liquidity.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了一个私人信息知情的大股东对公司进行监控并交易其股票的战略行为。私人信息导致在良好状态下的持股规模更大，但通过增加大股东的卖出速度，它可能导致在不利状态下的持股规模更小。尽管对预期持股规模产生了异质性影响，我们表明，信息不对称导致了帕累托改进：它提高了股票价格，使小型非知情股东受益，并且使持股者受益，尽管对流动性产生了负面影响。

papers.title_en: Acquisitions, Innovation and the Entrenchment of Monopoly
papers.title_zh: 收购、创新与垄断的巩固
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We analyze a dynamic model of repeated innovation where inventors may either be acquired by an incumbent or else resist takeover and challenge for leadership. In the short run, acquisitions always spur innovation because of the invention‐for‐buyout effect. In the longer run, however, they may stifle it because of a countervailing effect, the entrenchment of monopoly. The latter occurs when the incumbent's dominance depends on past levels of activity and is therefore reinforced by recurrent acquisitions. We show that if the entrenchment effect is sufficiently strong, forward‐looking policymakers should prohibit acquisitions in anticipation of the long‐run negative impact on innovation. This argument sets out a new theory of harm that can be used to block acquisitions that could otherwise go unchallenged.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们分析了一个重复创新的动态模型，其中发明者可能被在位企业收购，或者抵抗收购并挑战领导地位。短期内，收购总是由于发明-收购效应而刺激创新。然而，从长远来看，它们可能会因为垄断的固化效应而抑制创新。后者发生在在位企业的主导地位依赖于过去的活动水平，因此被反复的收购所加强。我们表明，如果固化效应足够强，具有前瞻性的决策者应该禁止收购，以预期对创新的长期负面影响。这一论点提出了一种新的损害理论，可以用来阻止那些否则可能不受挑战的收购。

papers.title_en: Inflated Recommendations
papers.title_zh: 膨胀的推荐
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Biased recommendations arise naturally in markets with heterogeneous consumers. We study a model in which a monopolist offers an experience good to a population of consumers with heterogeneous tastes and makes personalized purchase recommendations. We provide conditions under which a firm makes welfare‐reducing purchase recommendations with positive probability, resulting in inflated recommendations. We extend this insight to a setting in which an intermediary makes the recommendations, whereas a seller sets the retail price. Regulatory interventions that forbid inflated recommendations may lead to higher social welfare or may backfire.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在具有异质性消费者的市场中，有偏见的推荐自然产生。我们研究了一个模型，其中一家垄断者向具有异质性口味的消费者群体提供体验商品，并提供个性化购买推荐。我们提供了在何种条件下，企业以正概率做出减少福利的购买推荐，导致推荐膨胀。我们将这一洞见扩展到一个中介机构做出推荐，而卖家设定零售价格的情境。禁止膨胀推荐的监管干预可能会导致更高的社会福利，或者可能适得其反。

papers.title_en: Dynamic Pricing With Recommendation and Consumer Feedback
papers.title_zh: 动态定价、推荐与消费者反馈
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A long‐lived seller sells a new product of unknown value by offering prices and recommendations to short‐lived consumers in continuous time. The seller receives consumer feedback about the product at a rate that increases with the instantaneous sales volume. The optimal selling mechanism features episodes of price discounts, during which the seller discontinuously lowers the price and offers unwarranted recommendations to consumers. The optimal pricing strategy depends on the nature of consumer feedback and may involve early or late discounts, dynamic price backtracking, and below‐cost pricing.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：一个长期存在的卖家通过在连续时间内提供价格和建议，向短期存在的消费者销售一个价值未知的新产品。卖家收到关于产品的消费者反馈的速度随着即时销售量的增加而增加。最优销售机制包括价格折扣的阶段，在这些阶段中，卖家会不连续地降低价格并向消费者提供无保证的建议。最优定价策略取决于消费者反馈的性质，可能涉及早期或晚期折扣、动态价格回溯和低于成本的定价。

papers.title_en: Storage games
papers.title_zh: 存储博弈
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study a long‐horizon, oligopolistic market with random shocks to demand that can be arbitraged by two storage operators with finite capacity. This problem applies to any storable commodity—that is, most commodities. Because the arbitrage spread is so sensitive to market power, storage operators face strong incentives to restrain quantities by tacitly colluding. This cooperation takes new forms thanks to the multiplicity of actions they must take: selling, buying, or both. We construct payoff‐maximizing equilibria of this stochastic game, and uncover a new form of Partial Cooperation that trades off quantities and delay. While collusive, Partial Cooperation delivers higher consumer surplus thanks to the market power effect. Head‐on competition is not always an equilibrium of the long‐horizon game when market power becomes large enough. We draw implications for policy and suggest poorly competitive storage is a negative externality to the development of the underlying commodity—for example, renewable energy.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了一个长期、寡头垄断市场，该市场受到需求随机冲击的影响，这些冲击可以被两个有限容量的存储运营商套利。这个问题适用于任何可储存商品，即大多数商品。由于套利价差对市场力量极为敏感，存储运营商面临通过默契勾结来限制数量的强烈动机。由于他们必须采取多种行动：销售、购买或两者兼而有之，这种合作呈现出新的形式。我们构建了这个随机博弈的收益最大化均衡，并揭示了一种新的部分合作形式，即在数量和延迟之间进行权衡。尽管是勾结性的，部分合作由于市场力量效应，能够带来更高的消费者剩余。当市场力量变得足够大时，正面竞争并不总是长期博弈的均衡。我们为政策制定提出了启示，并建议竞争力不足的存储是底层商品发展的一种负外部性——例如，可再生能源。

papers.title_en: The Political Economy of Patent Buyouts
papers.title_zh: 专利收购的政治经济学
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Incentivizing innovation through buyouts may alleviate the social costs associated with patent power, but the political economy and feasibility of this potentially important financing mechanism have been understudied. We study an international setting of countries with different innovation and financing capabilities, and where financing governments rely on taxes to fund buyouts and care about the electoral popularity of their decisions. Subsequent distributional conflict arises between countries as some may benefit from the now‐public knowledge without contributing equally to financing, whereas taxpayers within a country may disagree over the desired extent of tax financing for buyouts. We show that these conflicts reduce the feasibility of buyouts relative to patents, identify the conditions under which this harms global welfare, and discuss possibilities for overcoming these constraints. The international public good and public financing dimensions of buyouts emerge as essential for understanding their potential to supplant patents and to improve social welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：通过收购激励创新可能减轻与专利权相关的社会成本，但这种潜在重要的融资机制的政治经济和可行性一直未得到充分研究。我们研究了一个国际背景，其中不同国家的创新和融资能力各异，而融资政府依赖税收来资助收购，并关心其决策的选举受欢迎程度。随后，国家之间出现了分配冲突，因为一些国家可能从现在公开的知识中受益，而没有平等地贡献资金，而一个国家的纳税人可能对税收资助收购的期望程度存在分歧。我们表明，这些冲突降低了收购相对于专利的可行性，确定了这种情况损害全球福利的条件，并讨论了克服这些限制的可能性。收购的国际公共产品和公共融资维度对于理解其取代专利和提高社会福利的潜力至关重要。

papers.title_en: Buyer‐Optimal Platform Design
papers.title_zh: 买家最优平台设计
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A platform matches a unit mass of sellers, each owning a single product of heterogeneous quality, to a unit mass of buyers with differing valuations for unit‐quality. After matching, sellers make take‐it‐or‐leave‐it price‐offers to buyers. Initially, valuations of buyers are only known to them and the platform, but sellers make inferences from the matching algorithm. The efficient matching is positive assortative, but buyer‐optimal matchings are stochastically negative assortative when there are few low‐value buyers (i.e., compared to lower‐quality sellers, high‐quality ones are matched to buyers with lower expected valuation). Although everyone trades, generating rents for the side lacking bargaining power results in inefficient matching.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：一个平台将拥有不同质量异质产品的单一单位质量卖家与对单位质量有不同估值的单一单位质量买家进行匹配。匹配后，卖家向买家提出接受或放弃的价格提议。最初，只有买家和平台知道买家的估值，但卖家会从匹配算法中推断。有效的匹配是正向选择性的，但当低估值买家较少时（即，与低质量卖家相比，高质量卖家与预期估值较低的买家匹配），买家最优匹配是随机负向选择性的。尽管每个人都进行交易，为缺乏议价能力的一方创造租金，但会导致匹配效率低下。

papers.title_en: Legalization and innovation in the cannabis market
papers.title_zh: 大麻市场的合法化与创新
papers.abstract_en: How would legal institutions affect the rate and direction of innovation in restricted or illicit markets? This paper studies the impact of legalization on innovation in the cannabis market. We construct novel data and measures on cannabis-related innovation in clinical trials and patent applications at the state-year level. We use staggered difference-in-differences models and event studies to analyze the impacts of medical and recreational cannabis legalization (MCL and RCL, respectively) on innovation. We find no evidence that cannabis-related clinical trials respond to MCLs or RCLs. However, there is a marked increase in cannabis-related patenting ( ∼ 4.4 patents) in response to an RCL and more modest impacts from an MCL ( ∼ 1.4 patents). Notably, additional RCL-induced patents are focused primarily on downstream products and methods rather than upstream medical innovation; MCL impacts show a similar pattern. Our further analysis of patent content suggests significant growth in areas that may raise public health, safety, and misuse concerns. These results suggest that legalization increases innovation in the cannabis market, but with relatively weak gains in areas pertinent to health and safe use. We corroborate our findings with multiple new empirical methods in the literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律制度如何影响受限或非法市场中的创新速度和方向？本文研究了合法化对大麻市场创新的影响。我们构建了关于大麻相关创新的新数据和度量，包括临床试验和专利申请，以州-年为单位。我们使用交错差异-差异模型和事件研究来分析医疗和娱乐大麻合法化（分别称为MCL和RCL）对创新的影响。我们发现，大麻相关的临床试验对MCL或RCL没有反应。然而，对RCL的反应中，大麻相关的专利申请显著增加（约4.4项专利），而MCL的影响则更为温和（约1.4项专利）。值得注意的是，由RCL额外引起的专利主要集中在下游产品和方法上，而不是上游的医疗创新；MCL的影响显示出类似的模式。我们对专利内容的进一步分析表明，在可能引发公共卫生、安全和滥用问题领域有显著增长。这些结果表明，合法化增加了大麻市场的创新，但在与健康和安全使用相关的领域收益相对较弱。我们用文献中多种新的实证方法来证实我们的发现。

papers.title_en: Making sense of wickedness: Directionality heuristics for challenge-led innovation policy
papers.title_zh: 理解邪恶：面向挑战的创新政策的方向性启发式
papers.abstract_en: This article contributes to the burgeoning literature on directionality challenges by introducing directionality heuristics as a lens to conceptualize how policymakers and other stakeholders interpret and respond to problems in challenge-led innovation policy. Our starting point is that the “wickedness” of problems is strongly shaped by subjective and context-specific perceptions. We therefore utilize and adapt a sense-making framework, originally developed in the management literature, to distinguish different ways in which actors engage with the complexity and uncertainty of such problems. Building on this perspective, we conceptualize directionality heuristics as domain-specific rules of thumb that guide how policymakers interpret and address problems. We demonstrate the usefulness of this concept by applying it retrospectively to the Dutch Mission-oriented Topsector and Innovation Policy. The illustration highlights how stakeholders' differing views on the wickedness of problems translate into particular directionality challenges as well as suitable practices to address those. We conclude by outlining three key propositions, which emphasize the main conceptual contributions and provide concrete paths for future research and policy. • Sense-making helps to understand how policymakers view and tackle wicked problems. • Directionality heuristics are mental shortcuts used to interpret and address problems. • Different degrees of wickedness call for different directionality heuristics. • Nescience creates additional directionality challenges for challenge-led policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文通过引入方向性启发式作为视角，为日益增长的方向性挑战文献做出贡献，以概念化政策制定者和其他利益相关者如何解释和应对挑战引领型创新政策中的问题。我们的出发点是，问题的“恶果”在很大程度上受到主观和情境特定的感知的影响。因此，我们利用并适应了最初在管理文献中发展起来的意义构建框架，以区分行动者与这类问题的复杂性和不确定性的不同互动方式。基于这一视角，我们将方向性启发式概念化为特定领域的经验法则，指导政策制定者如何解释和解决问题。我们通过将其应用于荷兰任务导向型顶级部门和创新政策，展示了这一概念的有用性。这一说明突出了利益相关者对问题恶果的不同观点如何转化为特定的方向性挑战以及解决这些问题的适当做法。我们最后概述了三个关键命题，强调了主要的概念贡献，并为未来的研究和政策提供了具体路径。• 意义构建有助于理解政策制定者如何看待和解决恶果问题。• 方向性启发式是用于解释和解决问题的心理捷径。• 不同程度的问题恶果需要不同的方向性启发式。• 无知为挑战引领型政策创造了额外的方向性挑战。
