papers.title_en: Face Validation of an Artificial Intelligence Driven Tool for Clinical Triaging in Australian Public Oral Healthcare: A Pilot Study
papers.title_zh: 澳大利亚公共口腔医疗临床分流中人工智能驱动工具的人脸验证：一项试点研究
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technology holds significant potential to drive innovation for value-based healthcare for Victorian public oral healthcare, Australia. This pilot study compared the clinical triage decision outcome of experienced dentists in prioritizing consumers with urgent dental care at Your Community Health, a community health service in Victoria, Australia, with those generated by the CoTreat AI-driven tool (CoTreat Pty Ltd, Australia). METHODS: Consecutive sampling of consumers were recruited for the 6-month pilot. Five clinical criteria were established to determine consumers with urgent care: (1) requires urgent extraction causing loss of upper or lower anterior teeth, (2) multiple teeth (≥15% of remaining dentition) with moderate/extensive dental caries, (3) abscessed tooth/teeth, (4) root caries, and (5) missing upper and lower anterior teeth. Face validation was undertaken to compare the agreement between the triage output returned by CoTreat (index test) and 2 experienced dentists (reference standard) in determining urgent care. RESULTS: A total of 173 consumers were triaged in this pilot study (mean age 61.9 years [SD 18.]). One-third (n = 57) were identified needing urgent care. CoTreat achieved 98.3% agreement with dentist clinical triage outcome (Cohen's k = 0.96), 100% sensitivity, and 97.5% specificity, with positive predictive value of 94.7% and negative predictive value of 100%. The most common triage criteria were missing anterior teeth (60.3%) and abscesses (20.7%). CONCLUSIONS: CoTreat demonstrated excellent agreement with dentists' clinical triage decisions. AI-driven tools, such as CoTreat, can advance value-based healthcare implementation by identifying consumers with urgent care needs for Victorian public oral healthcare.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：采用人工智能（AI）技术对于推动澳大利亚维多利亚州公共口腔保健的价值基础医疗创新具有重大潜力。本试点研究比较了在维多利亚州澳大利亚社区健康服务Your Community Health中，经验丰富的牙医在优先考虑急需牙科护理的消费者时的临床分诊决策结果，与CoTreat AI驱动工具（CoTreat Pty Ltd，澳大利亚）生成的结果。方法：连续抽样的消费者被招募参加为期6个月的试点。建立了五个临床标准来确定急需护理的消费者：（1）需要紧急拔牙导致上颌或下颌前牙缺失，（2）多颗牙齿（≥15%的剩余牙齿）中度/广泛龋齿，（3）脓肿牙齿/牙齿，（4）根龋，以及（5）缺失上颌和下颌前牙。进行面部验证，比较CoTreat（指数测试）返回的分诊输出与2位经验丰富的牙医（参考标准）在确定紧急护理时的一致性。结果：本试点研究共对173名消费者进行了分诊（平均年龄61.9岁[SD 18]）。三分之一（n = 57）被确定需要紧急护理。CoTreat与牙医临床分诊结果的一致性达到98.3%（Cohen's k = 0.96），敏感性100%，特异性97.5%，阳性预测值为94.7%，阴性预测值为100%。最常见的分诊标准是缺失前牙（60.3%）和脓肿（20.7%）。结论：CoTreat与牙医的临床分诊决策显示出极佳的一致性。像CoTreat这样的AI驱动工具，可以通过识别维多利亚州公共口腔保健中急需护理的消费者，推进价值基础医疗的实施。

papers.title_zh: 探索将碳排放纳入健康技术评估的方法：以远程患者监测为例

METHODS: eq; scenario analysis up to €0.21/kg) and added to costs. In multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA), 6 criteria including environmental impact were evaluated with Analytical Hierarchy Process, using stakeholder valuations. RESULTS: eq per patient), driven by device production, partly offset by reduced unplanned care, outpatient visits, and patient travel. Despite higher emissions, RPM remained cost-saving (€102 per patient) with a positive incremental net monetary benefit (€42); only 1% of cost difference was attributable to emissions. In the MCDA, RPM outperformed UC in 5 of 6 criteria, with UC only favored on environmental impact. papers.abstract_zh: 目的：研究如何应用两种方法论途径将环境结果纳入心脏手术后远程患者监测（RPM）与常规护理（UC）的卫生技术评估中。方法：在成本效益分析中，计算了RPM与UC之间的成本差异（每公斤0.21欧元）并加到成本中。在多标准决策分析（MCDA）中，使用分析层次过程评估了包括环境影响在内的6个标准，并使用利益相关者估值。结果：RPM的每患者等效成本较低，主要由设备生产驱动，部分被减少的非计划护理、门诊访问和患者旅行所抵消。尽管排放量更高，RPM仍然是节省成本的（每患者102欧元），具有正的增量净货币效益（42欧元）；成本差异中只有1%归因于排放。在MCDA中，RPM在6个标准中的5个标准上优于UC，UC仅在环境影响上受到青睐。利益相关者对环境标准赋予了适度的权重，导致RPM的整体价值得分更高（0.649对0.351）。结论：两种方法都是可行的，尽管RPM的碳排放量更高，但得出了相同的结论。在当前的碳价格下，经济评估影响很小，而MCDA允许明确的可持续性考虑，但对主观选择敏感。总体而言，环境结果可能更好地通过审议性的卫生技术评估流程来解决，更广泛的政策工具是减少医疗保健碳排放的关键。

papers.title_en: Estimating the Shares of the Value of Branded Pharmaceuticals Accruing to Manufacturers and to Patients in the Thai Healthcare System
papers.title_zh: 泰国医疗系统中品牌药品价值在制造商和患者之间的分配份额估算
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: This article aims to inform which pricing policies for new pharmaceuticals will benefit population health most, and which will not, by drawing out the implications of current pricing policy in Thailand for the value that new, branded pharmaceuticals bring to the population. METHODS: We quantify the lifecycle value in terms of net population health gains of 9 new, branded pharmaceutical and indication combinations by evaluating lifetime health gains and reimbursement costs, considering the availability of generics or biosimilars. We then analyze how the value is shared between the population and manufacturers. RESULTS: Two-thirds of the pharmaceutical and indication combinations generated net population health gains over their lifecycle, with more than 90% of the total potential net health effects benefiting patients within the Thai healthcare system. However, manufacturers received a low proportion of value. Key factors driving these outcomes included delayed adoption of new pharmaceuticals and entry of generics or biosimilars. Conversely, 2 pharmaceuticals that were approved despite being deemed cost-ineffective resulted in net losses to population health. CONCLUSIONS: Quantification of the lifecycle value of new pharmaceuticals can better inform policies that enhance population health. In Thailand, policies that could improve overall population health include earlier adoption of new pharmaceuticals alongside careful price regulation and expedited generic entry. These approaches could also provide mechanisms to signal research and development priorities effectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本文旨在通过分析泰国当前药品定价政策对新品牌药品为人群健康带来的价值的影响，来告知哪些新药品的定价政策最有利于人群健康，哪些则不然。方法：我们通过评估9种新品牌药品及其适应症组合的终身健康增益和报销成本，量化了其生命周期价值，并考虑了仿制药或生物类似药的可用性。然后分析了价值如何在人群和制造商之间共享。结果：三分之二的药品和适应症组合在其生命周期内产生了净人群健康增益，超过90%的总潜在净健康效应使泰国医疗保健系统内的患者受益。然而，制造商获得的价值比例较低。导致这些结果的关键因素包括新药品的采用延迟以及仿制药或生物类似药的进入。相反，尽管被认为成本效益不高，但有2种药品获批导致人群健康净损失。结论：量化新药品的生命周期价值可以更好地为提高人群健康的政策提供信息。在泰国，可以改善整体人群健康的政策包括尽早采用新药品，同时谨慎进行价格调控和加快仿制药的进入。这些方法还可以提供有效信号研发优先事项的机制。

papers.title_en: The Effect of Perspective, Duration, and Views on Death on the Valuation of Severe Health States
papers.title_zh: 视角、持续时间和死亡观对严重健康状况评估的影响
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Composite time trade-off utilities typically vary by perspective: adults tend to assign lower utilities to health states for themselves (self-perspective) than for children (proxy-perspective). Utilities also differ between proxy-perspectives: i.e., deciding for a child (proxy1) vs imagining what a child wants (proxy2). This can cause health states to be evaluated as better than dead (BTD) under one perspective, yet worse than dead (WTD) under another. We investigate how such WTD preferences vary with health states across durations and perspectives, alongside sociocultural factors such as religion and attitudes toward death. As a secondary analysis, we explore the maximal endurable time hypothesis to assess the consistency of WTD preferences. METHODS: We surveyed 1000 UK respondents, stratified into 2 groups by religious affiliation (religious vs nonreligious). Each completed BTD tasks from a self-perspective and a randomly assigned proxy perspective (proxy1 or proxy2), involving 5 health states across 4 durations. Respondents also ranked all health states (without duration) and immediate death. RESULTS: In ranking tasks without duration, WTD preferences were unaffected by perspective or religious affiliation, whereas the proportion of states considered WTD increased with longer durations in paired comparisons in the BTD tasks among nonreligious participants. WTD preferences were associated with stronger support for euthanasia and lower religiousness. Maximal endurable time preferences showed minimal differences across perspectives or religious affiliations. CONCLUSIONS: Perspectives, duration, religious affiliation, and views on euthanasia shape WTD preferences. Future research is encouraged to consider religion in sampling and how to deal with the potential duration dependency of QALY-anchored utilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：复合时间权衡效用通常因视角而异：成人倾向于为自己（自我视角）分配较低的健康状态效用，而为儿童（代理视角）分配较高的效用。代理视角之间也存在效用差异，即，为儿童做决定（代理1）与想象儿童想要什么（代理2）之间的区别。这可能导致某些健康状态在一种视角下被评估为比死亡更好（BTD），而在另一种视角下则被评估为比死亡更差（WTD）。我们研究了这种WTD偏好如何随着健康状态、持续时间以及视角的变化而变化，同时考虑了社会文化因素，如宗教和对死亡的态度。作为次要分析，我们探讨了最大可忍受时间假设，以评估WTD偏好的一致性。方法：我们调查了1000名英国受访者，按宗教信仰分为两组（宗教与非宗教）。每个人从自我视角和随机分配的代理视角（代理1或代理2）完成BTD任务，涉及5种健康状态和4个持续时间。受访者还对所有健康状态（不考虑持续时间）和立即死亡进行了排名。结果：在不考虑持续时间的排名任务中，WTD偏好不受视角或宗教信仰的影响，而在非宗教参与者中，随着BTD任务中持续时间的延长，被认为是WTD状态的比例在配对比较中增加。WTD偏好与对安乐死的更强支持和较低的宗教性相关。最大可忍受时间偏好在视角或宗教信仰之间显示出最小的差异。结论：视角、持续时间、宗教信仰和对安乐死的看法塑造了WTD偏好。鼓励未来的研究考虑抽样中的宗教因素，以及如何处理与QALY锚定效用潜在的持续时间依赖性。

papers.title_en: Qini Curves for Potential Impact Assessment of Risk Predictive Models Informing Intervention Policies
papers.title_zh: 秦尼曲线：评估风险预测模型对干预政策潜在影响
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Predictive models in medicine help make decisions about which individual to treat with a given therapeutic or preventive intervention. Before being tested in large field studies and recommended for clinical adoption, it is important to evaluate not only their statistical accuracy but also the impact they may have when used to inform health intervention policies. We aim to provide simple methods for the potential impact assessment of health intervention policies based on predictive models. METHODS: We propose an analytic framework based on Qini curves wherein prediction-based policies are analyzed on 2 impact endpoints: (1) the fraction of the population that would be selected for the intervention (coverage) and (2) the effect on the clinical outcomes of interest (disutility). The drivers of values are the disease prevalence, the predictive performance of the model, and the effectiveness of the intervention. RESULTS: We present simple formulas for calculating coverage and disutility from either observational or randomized controlled data. We illustrate possible value measures arising from geometrical properties on the Qini plane: delta coverage and disutility, number needed to treat, and integrated difference between Qini curves. We show the applicability of the Qini analysis by providing examples about the prevention of falls in older adults and prevention of secondary cardiovascular events with pioglitazone. CONCLUSIONS: Coverage and disutility capture key value components of prediction-based policies. The method can be used for comparing models or tuning risk thresholds for managing trade-offs between conflicting objectives (eg, clinical benefits, side effects, and healthcare resources).
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：医学中的预测模型有助于决定对哪些个体使用特定的治疗或预防干预措施。在进行大规模现场研究和推荐临床应用之前，评估这些模型不仅需要考虑它们的统计准确性，还需要评估它们在用于指导健康干预政策时可能产生的影响。我们旨在提供基于预测模型的健康干预政策潜在影响评估的简单方法。方法：我们提出了一个基于Qini曲线的分析框架，在此框架中，基于预测的政策在两个影响终点上进行分析：（1）将被选为干预对象的人口比例（覆盖率）和（2）对感兴趣的临床结果的影响（无用性）。这些值的驱动因素是疾病流行率、模型的预测性能和干预措施的有效性。结果：我们提出了从观察性或随机对照数据中计算覆盖率和无用性的简单公式。我们通过Qini平面上的几何属性说明了可能出现的价值度量：覆盖率和无用性的差异、需要治疗的人数，以及Qini曲线之间的综合差异。我们通过提供关于预防老年人跌倒和使用吡格列酮预防心血管次级事件的例子来展示Qini分析的适用性。结论：覆盖率和无用性捕捉了基于预测的政策的关键价值组成部分。该方法可用于比较模型或调整风险阈值，以管理相互冲突的目标之间的权衡（例如，临床效益、副作用和医疗资源）。

papers.title_en: Toward a Harmonized Health Technology Assessment Framework for Digital Health Technologies in Europe
papers.title_zh: 迈向欧洲数字健康技术统一健康技术评估框架
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The increasing use of digital health technologies (DHTs) in Europe presents opportunities and challenges. Although DHTs could enhance care delivery and health outcomes, existing health technology assessment (HTA) methods often lack flexibility to address their diverse, fast-evolving nature. This article explores the perspectives of 5 stakeholder groups-policy makers, HTA agencies, technology developers, healthcare providers, and patients-regarding the development of a harmonized HTA framework for DHTs within the Horizon Europe funded European Digital Health Technology Assessment (EDiHTA) project. METHODS: Findings are drawn from mixed-method research, including stakeholder surveys, interviews and focus groups with 97 stakeholders across European countries. The analysis of the data was performed per each stakeholder group through thematic analysis to identify points of consensus before identifying needs and requirements across stakeholders, relevant to the development of EDiHTA, using the Innovation Health Technology Assessment Methods framework. RESULTS: Results from 8 focus groups and more than 45 interviews are presented concentrating on 5 main themes. The emerging themes focus on the need for harmonization of HTA methods related to DHTs, the current characteristics of DHTs that are most highly valued, the importance of multistakeholder collaboration, the principles of a concept design for EDiHTA framework, and the discussion on the most relevant domains and criteria to be considered. CONCLUSIONS: Stakeholders agreed that a harmonized HTA framework is needed; however, differences persist regarding timing and flexibility of evaluation, evidence types, and stakeholder involvement. The EDiHTA project will address differences through framework piloting, supported by multistakeholder workshops and expert advisory groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：在欧洲，数字健康技术（DHTs）的日益普及带来了机遇和挑战。尽管DHTs可能增强护理服务和健康结果，但现有的健康技术评估（HTA）方法往往缺乏灵活性，无法应对其多样化和快速发展的特性。本文探讨了5个利益相关者群体——政策制定者、HTA机构、技术开发者、医疗保健提供者和患者——对于在欧洲地平线资助的欧洲数字健康技术评估（EDiHTA）项目中开发一个协调一致的DHTs HTA框架的观点。方法：研究结果来自混合方法研究，包括对97个欧洲国家利益相关者的调查、访谈和焦点小组讨论。数据分析是按照每个利益相关者群体通过主题分析进行的，以确定共识点，然后确定与EDiHTA开发相关的跨利益相关者的需求和要求，使用创新健康技术评估方法框架。结果：来自8个焦点小组和45多次访谈的结果集中在5个主要主题上。新出现的主题集中在需要协调与DHTs相关的HTA方法、当前最有价值的DHTs特性、多方利益相关者合作的重要性、EDiHTA框架的概念设计原则，以及讨论需要考虑的最相关领域和标准。结论：利益相关者一致认为需要一个协调一致的HTA框架；然而，在评估的时间和灵活性、证据类型以及利益相关者参与方面仍存在差异。EDiHTA项目将通过框架试点来解决这些差异，得到多方利益相关者研讨会和专家咨询小组的支持。

papers.title_zh: “社区大学”致力于减少当地环境危害
papers.abstract_en: Calvin Avant is partnering with residents, researchers, and activists to reduce environmental hazards in their communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 卡尔文·阿凡特正在与居民、研究人员和活动家合作，减少他们社区的环境危害。

papers.title_en: Participatory Systems Science To Identify Local Adaptation Strategies For Extreme Heat In King County, Washington
papers.title_zh: 参与式系统科学：识别华盛顿州金县极端高温的本地适应策略
papers.abstract_en: Extreme heat is a complex public health problem driven by interactions at the individual, community, health system, and policy levels. Participatory systems science engages interested parties to examine the interconnected factors driving heat-related illness and to develop locally tailored adaptation strategies. This article describes how local government agencies and community members from an area with high heat exposure in King County, Washington, engaged in the participatory systems science approach of group model building to co-develop extreme heat solutions during 2024-25. Recommended solutions included community education on heat risk; health system policies that increase access to health care; policy-informed infrastructure changes that expand access to green space; and lifesaving direct support, including distribution of cool kits to unhoused people and energy assistance programs. The insights generated can inform heat adaptation efforts across jurisdictions. The methods described offer a scalable approach to co-designing policies and interventions that can inform national and global climate resilience strategies to reduce health risks from climate-related events.
papers.abstract_zh: 极端高温是一个复杂的公共卫生问题，由个体、社区、卫生系统和政策层面的相互作用驱动。参与式系统科学让利益相关方参与进来，审视导致与热相关的疾病的相互关联因素，并开发本地化的适应策略。本文描述了华盛顿州金县一个高温暴露高的地区，当地政府机构和社区成员如何参与2024-25年的参与式系统科学方法——群体建模，共同开发极端高温解决方案。推荐的解决方案包括对热风险的社区教育；增加获得医疗保健机会的卫生系统政策；政策指导的基础设施变化，扩大对绿地的获取；以及救生直接支持，包括向无家可归者分发凉爽工具包和能源援助计划。产生的洞见可以为各管辖区的热适应工作提供信息。所描述的方法提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于共同设计政策和干预措施，这些措施可以为国家和全球气候韧性战略提供信息，以减少与气候相关的事件带来的健康风险。

papers.title_en: Menu Changes Under NYC’s Revised Food Standards Were Associated With A Reduction In Greenhouse Gas Emissions
papers.title_zh: 纽约市修订食品标准下的菜单变化与温室气体排放减少相关
papers.abstract_en: Local policy makers increasingly have implemented nutrition standards for municipal programs to advance population health and climate change goals. Yet little is known about the impact of these policies. In 2008, New York City established nutrition standards for food purchased and served by city agencies, and in 2022, it revised the standards to limit meat and increase plant-based options. Using menu data from four agencies serving 77 percent of all city meals, we examined changes in their entrée offerings, as well as greenhouse gas and nutrition content associated with their total menu offerings, from fiscal year 2019 through fiscal year 2024. All agencies reduced the frequency of beef entrées offered on menus and increased the frequency of vegetarian entrées. Changes in total menu offerings were associated with an estimated reduction of 0.64 kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent in greenhouse gas emissions per portion across all agencies and programs, while the nutrition content generally remained consistent. These findings suggest that municipal food standards can support greenhouse gas reductions without compromising nutrition, and they offer a model for other jurisdictions seeking to advance both population and environmental health goals.
papers.abstract_zh: 地方政策制定者越来越多地实施市政项目的营养标准，以推进人口健康和气候变化目标。然而，这些政策的影响尚不清楚。2008年，纽约市为城市机构购买和提供的食品建立了营养标准，并在2022年修订了这些标准，以限制肉类并增加植物性选择。我们利用四个机构的菜单数据，这些机构提供了全市77%的餐食，检查了他们的主菜供应变化，以及与他们总菜单供应相关的温室气体和营养含量，从2019财年到2024财年。所有机构都减少了菜单上提供的牛肉主菜的频率，并增加了素食主菜的频率。总菜单供应的变化与所有机构和项目每份食物温室气体排放估计减少0.64公斤二氧化碳当量相关，而营养含量总体上保持一致。这些发现表明，市政食品标准可以在不损害营养的情况下支持温室气体减排，它们为其他寻求推进人口和环境健康目标的司法管辖区提供了一个模式。

papers.title_en: From Crisis To Strategy: Mainstreaming Climate Risk In Health Systems Planning
papers.title_zh: 从危机到战略：将气候风险纳入卫生系统规划主流
papers.abstract_en: Climate change poses a growing threat to health care systems worldwide, exposing weaknesses in infrastructure, workforce, and governance. Climate risk-defined by the interaction of hazard, exposure, and vulnerability-is both similar to and distinct from other systemic risks that health care systems must manage. We propose a risk-based framework that integrates insights from disaster risk management and health systems thinking to identify adaptation strategies. Our approach emphasizes understanding and addressing the upstream determinants of climate risk, including the intersectoral operating environment and social and environmental vulnerabilities that amplify health impacts. This perspective links climate risk reduction to the broader agenda of health equity. Within the health sector, climate change exerts simultaneous pressure on both demand and supply, challenging systems to move from reactive crisis response toward proactive, risk-informed planning. Established tools-such as strategic investment, workforce planning, and emergency preparedness-can be leveraged to manage climate-related risks while advancing core health policy goals. Framing climate change as a systemic risk encourages the integration of climate considerations into everyday policy and planning and strengthens health care system performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 气候变化对全球卫生保健系统构成了日益增长的威胁，暴露了基础设施、劳动力和治理方面的弱点。气候风险——由危害、暴露和脆弱性相互作用定义——既与其他卫生保健系统必须管理的系统性风险相似，也有其独特之处。我们提出了一个基于风险的框架，整合了灾害风险管理和卫生系统思维的见解，以识别适应策略。我们的方法强调理解和解决气候风险的上游决定因素，包括跨部门运营环境以及放大健康影响的社会和环境脆弱性。这种视角将减少气候风险与更广泛的健康公平议程联系起来。在卫生领域，气候变化同时对需求和供应施加压力，挑战系统从被动的危机应对转向主动的、基于风险的规划。可以利用已建立的工具——如战略投资、劳动力规划和紧急准备——来管理与气候相关的风险，同时推进核心卫生政策目标。将气候变化框架为系统性风险，鼓励将气候考虑因素融入日常政策和规划，并加强卫生保健系统的表现。

papers.title_en: Aligning Health Policy With Climate Action: Evidence-Based Interventions To Decarbonize Care, Improve Climate Resilience
papers.title_zh: 将卫生政策与气候行动对齐：基于证据的干预措施以脱碳护理，提高气候韧性
papers.abstract_en: The US health care system significantly contributes to climate change while increasingly facing its adverse consequences. Despite this dual challenge, policy efforts to incentivize carbon reduction and make care delivery climate-resilient remain fragmented. In this article, we identify policy interventions and other strategies that have the potential to accelerate the transition toward low-carbon, climate-smart health care systems. Drawing on academic literature and real-world implementation examples, we present a framework of strategies, highlighting the evidence in support of mechanisms such as green reimbursement models, integration of climate change into health professional education, and sustainable procurement standards. We further examine emerging policy levers, including circular economy practices and mandated carbon accounting. Last, we highlight opportunities for federal and state policy makers, payers, and health system leaders to guide future action. Ensuring that health policies actively support climate mitigation and adaptation is a moral and environmental imperative and a strategic opportunity to improve quality, reduce costs, and advance health equity.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国医疗保健系统对气候变化有显著贡献，同时越来越多地面临其不利后果。尽管存在这一双重挑战，激励减少碳排放和使护理交付适应气候的政策努力仍然支离破碎。在本文中，我们确定了有潜力加速向低碳、气候智能医疗保健系统过渡的政策干预和其他策略。我们借鉴学术文献和现实世界的实施案例，提出了一个策略框架，强调支持绿色报销模式、将气候变化纳入卫生专业教育以及可持续采购标准的机制的证据。我们进一步检查了包括循环经济实践和强制碳核算在内的新兴政策杠杆。最后，我们强调了联邦和州政策制定者、支付者和卫生系统领导者指导未来行动的机会。确保卫生政策积极支持气候缓解和适应是一项道德和环境要求，也是提高质量、降低成本和推进健康公平的战略机遇。

papers.title_en: Creating Climate Change Action Within Communities
papers.title_zh: 在社区内创造气候变化行动
papers.abstract_en: Amanda Li works with ecoAmerica to spark climate change conversations and action within local communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 阿曼达·李与ecoAmerica合作，在本地社区中激发关于气候变化的对话和行动。

papers.title_en: Reimagining Disaster Response: A New Vision For Community Resilience In The Texas And Louisiana Gulf Coast
papers.title_zh: 重塑灾难响应：德克萨斯和路易斯安那海湾沿岸社区韧性的新愿景
papers.abstract_en: The use of community-rooted resilience models by locally governed systems across the Gulf Coast of Texas and Louisiana demonstrates how preparedness, response, and recovery in historically disinvested communities can be strengthened in disaster-prone areas. Drawing on qualitative interviews of people in this region that were conducted in 2025, we present four case studies here, showing how community, health, and government partnerships maintain essential services, power, and communication during crises. These findings highlight policy gaps and the need for investment in equitable, community-based disaster infrastructure and long-term resilience capacity.
papers.abstract_zh: 德克萨斯和路易斯安那州墨西哥湾沿岸地区由地方治理系统采用的社区根基型韧性模型展示了如何在历史上投资不足的社区中加强灾害多发地区的准备、响应和恢复能力。基于2025年在该地区进行的定性访谈，我们在此呈现了四个案例研究，展示了社区、健康和政府合作伙伴如何在危机期间维持基本服务、电力和通信。这些发现突出了政策缺口以及对公平、基于社区的灾害基础设施和长期韧性能力的投资需求。

papers.title_en: Empowering South Los Angeles Tenants To Advance Climate Policies That Protect Their Rights
papers.title_zh: 赋予南洛杉矶租户推进保护其权益的气候政策的能力
papers.abstract_en: This article tells the story of vulnerable tenants in South Los Angeles, California, and their work with a community-based organization to advance policies that address climate change while also protecting tenant rights. Climate change is having a disproportionately negative impact on low-income renters in South Los Angeles, where housing is often crowded, unaffordable, and poorly maintained, and extreme heat events can make indoor living unbearable. Cooling mandates and improvements such as building decarbonization can help. Because landlords have used remodeling and renovations as an excuse for harassment or eviction, tenants have been wary of these policies' unintended consequences. But with ongoing education and partnership with a community organization, tenants are now supporting and successfully advocating for policies that address the root causes of climate change and create healthier homes while providing protections that preserve tenants' access to safe and affordable housing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文讲述了加利福尼亚州南洛杉矶的弱势租户与一个社区组织合作，推动既应对气候变化又保护租户权益的政策。气候变化对南洛杉矶的低收入租房者产生了不成比例的负面影响，那里的住房常常拥挤、负担不起且维护不善，极端高温事件可能使室内居住变得难以忍受。制冷规定和建筑脱碳等改进措施可以提供帮助。由于房东曾以翻新和装修为借口进行骚扰或驱逐，租户对这些政策的意外后果持谨慎态度。但通过持续教育和与社区组织的合作，租户现在支持并成功倡导解决气候变化根本原因的政策，同时创造更健康的家园，并提供保护措施，以维护租户获得安全和负担得起的住房的机会。

papers.title_en: Latino Climate And Health Dashboard: Community-Informed Implementation, Data, And Policy Action
papers.title_zh: 拉丁裔气候与健康仪表板：社区信息驱动的实施、数据和政策行动
papers.abstract_en: Latino communities in California experience disproportionate climate-related health risks, including extreme heat and air pollution. Despite the state's leadership in climate and environmental justice policy, existing data systems often do not integrate climate exposures, health outcomes, or neighborhood-level vulnerability in ways that meaningfully inform policy action. This Analysis draws on insights from the Latino Climate and Health Dashboard, a publicly available, neighborhood-level data tool that documents disparities between Latino and non-Latino White neighborhoods across California. The dashboard was developed with advisory board guidance, using the EPIS (exploration, preparation, implementation, sustainment) framework to structure data development and engagement. After the dashboard's release, we convened community policy dialogues ("policy pláticas") in which community organization leaders, practitioners, advocates, and legislative staff interpreted the findings and identified five policy priorities: coordinated climate and air quality governance, sustained community monitoring and early warning systems, equitable cooling and infrastructure investments, stronger connections between climate policy and health outcomes, and climate-resilient access to health care and worker protections. A participatory data tool can support equity-oriented climate-health policy making and inform efforts to translate data into policy action.
papers.abstract_zh: 加利福尼亚州的拉丁裔社区承受着不成比例的与气候相关的健康风险，包括极端高温和空气污染。尽管该州在气候和环境正义政策方面处于领导地位，但现有的数据系统通常不会以有意义的方式整合气候暴露、健康结果或社区层面的脆弱性，以指导政策行动。本分析基于拉丁裔气候与健康仪表板的见解，这是一个公开可用的社区层面数据工具，记录了加利福尼亚州拉丁裔和非拉丁裔白人社区之间的差异。该仪表板是在咨询委员会的指导下开发的，使用EPIS（探索、准备、实施、维持）框架来构建数据开发和参与。仪表板发布后，我们召集了社区政策对话（“政策pláticas”），社区组织领导人、从业者、倡导者和立法工作人员在其中解释了调查结果，并确定了五个政策优先事项：协调气候和空气质量治理，持续的社区监测和早期预警系统，公平的降温和基础设施投资，气候政策与健康结果之间更强的联系，以及气候适应性的健康护理和工人保护。参与式数据工具可以支持以公平为导向的气候健康政策制定，并指导将数据转化为政策行动的努力。

papers.title_en: Unequal Exposure: Examining Outdoor Work And Climate Exposure In The US
papers.title_zh: 不平等暴露：审视美国户外工作与气候暴露
papers.abstract_en: Outdoor workers face growing exposure to poor air quality, wildfire smoke, and extreme heat, yet protections remain uneven across states and incomplete federally, and little is known about outdoor workers. We combined data from national labor-force surveys with occupation-based exposure data and county-level environmental indicators on air quality, wildfire, and heat waves to describe and compare outdoor and indoor workers. Outdoor workers accounted for 21.9 percent of the workforce in 2023. About 16.9 percent of outdoor workers lived in counties with the highest frequency of unhealthy air quality days, and nearly one-third lived in counties with the highest wildfire (32.4 percent) and heat wave (31.4 percent) risks. Compared with indoor workers, outdoor workers had higher rates of uninsurance, more self-employment, lower access to paid sick leave, and higher rates of work injuries. Results identified outdoor workforces with elevated climate-related risks and differences in coverage and job arrangements, informing federal, state, and local prevention, standards, and enforcement.
papers.abstract_zh: 户外工作者越来越多地暴露在糟糕的空气质量、野火烟雾和极端高温中，然而各州的保护措施参差不齐，联邦层面也不完整，对户外工作者的了解甚少。我们将国家劳动力调查数据与基于职业的暴露数据以及县级环境指标（包括空气质量、野火和热浪）结合起来，描述并比较户外和室内工作者。2023年，户外工作者占劳动力的21.9%。约16.9%的户外工作者居住在空气质量不健康天数最多的县，近三分之一居住在野火（32.4%）和热浪（31.4%）风险最高的县。与室内工作者相比，户外工作者的未保险率更高，自雇比例更大，带薪病假的获取率更低，工伤率更高。研究结果识别了面临较高气候相关风险的户外劳动力以及在覆盖范围和工作安排上的差异，为联邦、州和地方的预防、标准和执法提供了信息。

papers.title_en: Farmers And Ranchers: The Stress And Anxiety Fueled By Climate Change, And Interventions That Could Help
papers.title_zh: 农民与牧场主：气候变化引发的紧张与焦虑，以及可能的干预措施
papers.abstract_en: Farmers and ranchers are on the front lines of climate change, facing escalating production pressures, economic uncertainty, and profound psychological impacts. Drawing on first-person experience and research in agricultural communities, this Commentary uses narrative to illuminate how climate grief-grief experienced in response to actual or anticipated loss resulting from climate change-affects farmers and ranchers and shapes their capacity for climate adaptation. In addition to this experiential framing, the authors include an illustrative example of a team-developed intervention designed to support farmers' and ranchers' mental health; this example is offered not as original research but as a practice-based case to stimulate the broader policy conversation. Taken together, these perspectives underscore the need to integrate mental health support into agricultural climate resilience efforts. Although programs such as the Department of Agriculture's Farm and Ranch Stress Assistance Network represent important progress, current initiatives remain fragmented and underresourced. Research on mental health interventions related to climate change in general is sparse. Increasing investment and coherent policy are essential to ensuring that climate adaptation strategies address the full spectrum of challenges that farmers and ranchers face-physical, economic, and psychological.
papers.abstract_zh: 农民和牧场主处于气候变化的前线，面临着不断增加的生产压力、经济不确定性和深远的心理影响。本文通过农业社区的第一手经验和研究，利用叙述手法阐明气候悲伤——对气候变化导致的或预期的损失的反应中所经历的悲伤——如何影响农民和牧场主，并塑造他们适应气候变化的能力。除了这种体验性的框架外，作者还提供了一个团队开发的旨在支持农民和牧场主心理健康的干预措施的示例；这个例子不是作为原创研究提供的，而是作为一个基于实践的案例，以激发更广泛的政策对话。综合这些观点，强调了将心理健康支持纳入农业气候适应努力的必要性。尽管像农业部的农场和牧场压力援助网络这样的项目代表了重要的进展，但目前的举措仍然支离破碎，资源不足。与气候变化相关的心理健康干预研究普遍缺乏。增加投资和连贯的政策对于确保气候适应策略解决农民和牧场主面临的全方位挑战——身体、经济和心理——至关重要。

papers.title_en: Who Pays When Temperatures Soar?
papers.title_zh: 高温时谁买单？
papers.abstract_en: The health effects of extreme heat have gained attention rapidly, as rising global temperatures cause more frequent and severe heat waves. More attention is needed, however, to the myriad pathways by which the financial and physical tolls of extreme heat are ultimately borne by the most disadvantaged members of society. These tolls include direct impacts on health and indirect impacts on income as costs incurred by industry, government, and other entities are passed on to individuals as increased prices or decreased earnings. Strained household finances in turn affect individuals' ability to pursue a healthy lifestyle and seek medical care. Existing research says little about transmission of these effects between individuals and organizations, however. We explore current evidence, identify gaps in this research, and recommend priorities for future work to promote more comprehensive understanding of the direct and indirect impacts of rising temperatures on health and financial well-being.
